items.question: What happens when the practitioner is possessed by the goddess?
items.inference: The practitioner becomes and remains possessed by the goddess.
items.plain_english: Then he is always possessed, and such possession always remains.

items.question: What role and actions follow from this possession?
items.inference: As love-lord he continually performs enjoyments of desire.

items.question: What freedoms and qualities characterize this liberated state?
premises: Freed from old age and death

items.plain_english: Freed from old age and death, he is a great enjoyer and greatly happy.
